text:
maria: Quick cross-team check — optimize toolkit delivery status please. Need owners for quant recs, batching config, and a plan for the regression Priya flagged. Can everyone drop 1-line status + blockers?

jin: I picked up the canary rollout PR (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optkit/pull/582). Code compiles, unit tests green, waiting infra sign-off for reserved GPUs.

ava: Quant recs are done for the initial models (gpt-like & llama variants). Recommendation: symmetric per-channel int8 for weights + fp16 activations. On our microbench, int8 -> ~1.7-1.9x token throughput, latency ~+5-7% tail. I'll attach perf table in the PR.

sam: For batching/caching I suggest enabling continuous batching with max_batch_size=16 and latency_slo_ms=120 for the canary. Also enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts. Sample config: ```batching: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 16, max_wait_ms: 12} cache: {prefix_kv: true, ttl_seconds: 300}```

priya: FYI regression alert: eval-suite v2 ran against customer-support prompts — generation quality dropped ~3% rouge-L on a subset after quantization. Not catastrophic but close to threshold. I recommend canary start at 1% traffic for 24h, measure regression metrics + human spot checks.

maria: OK ownership clarifications: jin = rollout owner, ava = quant owner, sam = runtime/batching owner, priya = quality gate. Jin, can you set canary 1% -> 5% step after 24h if no regressions? Also please add rollback playbook snippet in the PR.

jin: Yep. I'll update the PR with canary plan and rollback steps. Schedule: canary start tomorrow 09:00 PT, monitor for 48h. @deploy-bot can you remind infra to reserve 2x A100s for canary window?

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: reserve 2x A100 (canary) at 2024-04-12T09:00:00-07:00.

ava: One more perf note — for mixed workloads (short chat + long generation) enable dynamic batching heuristics; it avoids latency cliffs. I can add a heuristic script to the runtime repo, needs a quick CR from @sam.

sam: I can review the heuristic CR today. If it's small, we can include it in canary.

priya: I'll run an additional eval with a held-out set focused on persona/context preservation before the canary. ETA end of day.

maria: Great — blockers: infra reserve and final sign-off on quality metrics. Action items: jin add rollout doc + PR link, ava attach perf table + quant knobs, sam CR review, priya final eval. If anything slips ping here. :thumbsup:

jin: Actioned. PR updated with canary steps and rollback. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optkit/pull/582 — added checklist. :shipit:

ava: Perf table uploaded. Added quant tuning params and a note on when to fallback to fp16 for specific queries.

sam: CR reviewed and minor nits left. Will approve after tests.

priya: Extra eval finished — no new regressions on holdout, the 3% drop was concentrated in 12 prompts. I'll annotate them in the eval dashboard and flag which we should keep an eye on.

maria: Perfect. Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the 24h canary step.
